title: I met an Entity named Three
content: Edit: Idk why i got a warning but this is NOT RP. I just woke up from this dream maybe an hour ago. All this really happened. Or really... didnt happen. Idk dreams are confusing. In my dream last night, I met an entity from "The Void" who told me its name was Three. Three was a giant pool of black goo, smoke, tentacles and eyes, with a central mouth like a star fish or sea anemone. Wide and long, Three stretched across the ceiling of the warehouse room we were in. It spoke in a very kind but cryptic voice and was very patient. I was hanging with some guy when Three appeared and he was so afraid he tried to harm it in some way, throwing rocks. Cans. I just waited for what Three had to say. It said it was stuck where it was from, on the other side of the wall, and it would prefer to live here. I told it I'd seen where it was from and i agreed. "Anything would be better than The Void, a sea of dark where terrifying creatures live. No offense, present company excluded." I ordered the guy to find me a very specific item, a robotic, anthropomorphic lamb, about 3 feet tall. Lamby. He was programmed with a very basic AI that was able to make simple responses in a very "children's toy" kind of way. The guy was very upset. He threatened to find a way to kill Three. "I dunno man, he doesn't seem like he's gonna let you be. Maybe eat em?" I said, at this point becoming kind of bored and irritated that I'm having to put up with the insubordination. He whined about not wanting to die before Three spoke up. "Y̷̨̛̝̜̬͆͌̾o̵̫̾̄́̿ŭ̵̘̺ͅ ̷̛̞̥̇̚w̴̮̜̬͋̃͑͒o̸̺̝͗͌͊̔n̶̝̦̤̙̑̃'̴̨͔̞̖͆̆t̵̮͙̀ ̴̡̝͙͇̊̔̏̚d̵̠̏̉̋͜͠į̷̱̮̏͒ȅ̶̞̩̝͂̃͒." Three spoke in what i would assume Zalgo text SOUNDS like, with a static-y, two toned voice, sounding like a young woman and young man simultaneously. Three ate the man. Picked him up with a tentacle and shoved him into the central mouth hole. Then Three ate Lamby. I guess "ate" isnt the right word. More like Absorbed. After a while, there was a rumble inside Three, and he began to shrink, and surround something inside of him, like paper being wadded around an obect, he began to take a new shape. Four legs, standing on two. A muzzle. Glass eyeballs. Lamby. When he was done transforming he asked "Okay! Im actually here! Can I go with you?" I was like sure, bud. From there, Lamby was in my passenger seat.
